hierarchy-bundles.visual_critic_note: Clean typographic hierarchy and warm analogous palette show some design intent, but the circle pack visualization is cropped at the bottom (layout sizing bug), and the dense dark bundled edges form an illegible tangle that obscures the hierarchical structure it's meant to reveal.
hierarchy-bundles.encoding_integrity_note: Correct scaleSqrt for force-layout node radii and sunburst radial scale, data-driven domains via d3.extent, and key functions present in data joins; sunburst applies scaleSqrt to radial depth (distorts level spacing) without documentation, but no lie-factor violations or baseline truncation since no bar/area encodings exist.
hierarchy-bundles.stress_test_note: Easing-param sliders fire updateLayout() (full 1500ms transition) on every input event with no debounce or RAF coalescing; no .interrupt() before new layout transitions; broken .transitioning guard on tension slider (class never set, guard always passes); drag handler has no .filter() to prevent touch/mouse double-fire.
hierarchy-bundles.cognitive_load_note: The 300 bundled edges produce a dense hairball at center in the default circle-pack view, overwhelming the otherwise legible hierarchy; the dual hierarchical+network encoding doubles cognitive demand, and flubber morph quality across 200 nodes and 8 layout switches cannot be assessed from a static screenshot.
